profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Codecademy
profile.summary:
👋 I'm a Senior Software Engineer with a strong background in building scalable web applications and leading technical projects across EdTech, gaming, and ecommerce. At Codecademy, I implemented our A/B testing platform and now use it to ship and validate new features that best serve our learners and optimize the subscription funnel. I'm also currently expanding our B2B offerings to reach more enterprise clients.

Previously at FanDuel, I led platform expansions for international markets and helped modernize key user experiences with React. I began my journey at Synapse, developing revenue-driving ecommerce applications.

🔧 I work with modern technologies including TypeScript, React, Next.js, Go, Postgres, and GraphQL — always focused on clean architecture, performance, and data-driven decisions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Tech led projects like Codecademy Coaching and the Teams Summary Dashboard, and worked on improving our subscription funnel through A/B testing across checkout, pricing, and landing pages. Built internal experimentation tools, developed data visualization features, and created upgrade flows between subscription tiers. Also maintained and improved the Teams product and checkout experience, while helping migrate parts of the codebase from JavaScript to TypeScript and strengthening our analytics setup.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Migrated legacy UI to React/TypeScript, expanded test coverage with Jest and Cypress, and integrated with Node.js/Express and REST/GraphQL APIs while supporting internationalization and deployment. Became a go-to resource for engineers, mentoring teammates and driving best practices, leading to promotion to Senior Software Engineer.

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description: Created and maintained reliable e-commerce web applications using React, SCSS, Redux. Increased conversion rate for multiple funnels with successful A/B tests.

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description: Updated Purchase College Library's Interlibrary Loan website using Bootstrap 4 and jQuery. The website is used by students and staff to borrow books/media from other libraries when the item is not available at their college's.

positions.title: Teacher
positions.description: Coditum is a hands on learning experience available to kids ages 10-18 at SUNY Purchase where they learn and practice the basics of Python or Java including advanced college topics in computer science. While working as a teacher I had an opportunity to expand my knowledge, and also allowed me to cement my learnings from our own college CS courses. Topics that we teach: Python/Java syntax, basic console games, sorting algorithms, data structures.

honors.title: Award for Outstanding Senior in Computer Science
honors.description: This award is presented to a highly-respected Math/Computer Science senior with a strong academic record.

honors.title: Best Emotional Hack
honors.description: My team's project "Candy Bot" was awarded the Best Emotional Hack award in NYC. The project was a raspberryPi controlled bot that would dispense candy when it recognized an anxious or stressed face using Clarifai's AI models.
honors.issuer: Issued by Global AI Hackathon · Jul 2017

volunteerExperiences.description: Working with the fire department to give back to the community was a great and rewarding experience.

projects.title: Forest
projects.description: A mood tracking and self-growth web app with daily check-ins, emotional pattern insights, and guided reflection tools.

projects.title: Digitaizer
projects.description: Numerical digit recognition web application and service. This project was built as a "proof of concept" to my senior project research on neural networks.
